remarks: Marina Bay - the best of coastal living with everyday convenience! Designed for today's lifestyle, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath Shippan Point townhouse offers an open main level where the kitchen flows into the dining area and living room with fireplace, with sliders leading to a deck overlooking park-like grounds. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a renovated bath and private balcony, while two bedrooms share an updated full bath. The walkout lower level with patio extends your living space, ideal for a family room, playroom, or office. Hardwood floors, an attached garage, and a storage area add to the appeal. Community lifestyle perks include a clubhouse, pool overlooking the Sound, kayak racks, bike room, and grills. Ideally located steps from beaches and parks, and only minutes to Metro-North, Harbor Point, and downtown Stamford.
